title: Mass Effect N6
author: Well-Prepared Productions
description:
A fan made project set 20 years before the events of the first Mass Effect. You play as Burr Abelard, shamed N7 reject and perpetual drunkard. Your mission: To matter. Or at least, it used to be.

The arrival of a new alien species may be your ticket to shape your future. Will you redeem yourself, or will you sink further into infamy?

Travel through the dark parts of the galaxy, mingle with the planets and races that Shepard didn't. Just don't expect a hero's welcome.

I originally wrote this as a writing sample for a job application. If you happen to play and like this during my lifetime, let me know if you want to see more!
